Ticket SEND-LIST: work through these steps in order.
1. Read the sources and the tests before any change.
2. Measure the head of each row and whether it moved since the last look.
3. Record each row with the time, and name every row whose head is behind.
4. Compare the head with the merged head; the first look found 3 rows.
5. Keep the gate log beside the record.
6. Hand back the head and the gate counts.
